summary.text: Bob Lynn (listed on Ballotpedia as Robert J. Lynn) is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 17 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
A former federal prosecutor, he previously served on the New Hampshire Supreme Court, including as chief justice.

paragraphs.text: Robert J. Lynn was born in West Haven, Connecticut, and earned a B.S. in criminal justice from the University of New Haven in 1971 and a J.D. from the University of Connecticut School of Law in 1975.

His career experience includes work as a federal prosecutor with the U.S. Attorney's Office, executive editor of the Connecticut Law Review, and a special agent with the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration.
Ballotpedia lists him as an associate justice of the New Hampshire Supreme Court from 2010 to 2018 and as chief justice from 2018 to 2019.
His House tenure began in 2020, according to Ballotpedia, and he chaired the House Judiciary Committee in the 2023-2024 session after serving on the House Finance Committee in 2021-2022.
